definitions.gloss: reprint; extra print of a photograph
definitions.explanation: An additional printed copy of a photograph, made from the same negative or digital file. Also used figuratively to mean a rehash or repetition of something.

examples.japanese: この{写真|しゃしん}の{焼|や}き{増|ま}しを{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I ordered a reprint of this photo.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{増|ま}しは{一枚|いちまい}いくらですか。
この{映画|えいが}は{前作|ぜんさく}の{焼|や}き{増|ま}しにすぎない。
examples.english: This movie is nothing more than a rehash of the previous one.

notes:
USAGE:
Originally a photography term for making additional prints from a negative. Also used figuratively to criticize something as an unoriginal repetition. With the decline of film photography, the literal use has become less common, but the figurative meaning remains active.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼|や}き{増|ま}しをする (to make reprints)
- {焼|や}き{増|ま}しを{頼|たの}む (to order reprints)
- {前作|ぜんさく}の{焼|や}き{増|ま}し (a rehash of the previous work)
